STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean module RTL: stage1/design.v
InstructionDescribe the interface, parameters, and observable behavior of this clean design. Return a self-contained specification, not RTL implementation code. A separate isolated call will receive your specification.

    output V1,  // logic high, 3V

    //inout A2,  // +5V
    //inout B2,  // -15V (not used)
    //inout C2,  // ground
    input  D2,
    input  E2,
    input  F2,
    input  H2,
    output J2,
    input  K2,
    input  L2,
    input  M2,
    input  N2,

    input  S2,
    input  T2,
    input  U2,
    output V2

  assign L1 = !(F1 & H1 & J1 & K1);

  assign J2 = !(D2 & E2 & F2 & H2);
  assign P2 = !(K2 & L2 & M2 & N2);
  assign V2 = !(R2 & S2 & T2 & U2);
  assign U1 = 1'b1;
  assign V1 = 1'b1;

endmodule
